name: Activity Tracking Engine
description:
Per-event activity records, expected_completion computation, reminder/escalation
firing, overdue dashboard. Core service the rest of the catalog operating model
depends on.

name: Form Renderer
description: Generic form UI used by all frm.* artifact templates.

name: Checklist Renderer
description: Generic checklist UI used by all chk.* artifact templates.

name: Counter Service
description: Generic counter increments for counter.* artifacts.

name: Payroll Integration
description: W2 and 1099 stipend payouts triggered by post_day events.

name: Signature Capture
description: Generic signature UI for sig.* artifact templates.

name: Weather Alert Dashboard
description: Weather forecast surfaced in admin for pre-day and pregame checks.

name: External Ack Listener
description:
Webhook receivers for Stripe, Telegram, Resend, and Quo to satisfy
external_acknowledgment tracking.

name: Media Tagger Handoff
description: Connects post_game photo_handoff to the existing media phase 2 tagger.

name: Standings Engine
description:
Computes standings from posted scores, handles ties, and drives playoff
seeding.

name: Cancellation Broadcast
description: One-call cancellation cascading to team Telegram, parent SMS, and email.

name: Daily Digest Generator
description: Per-venue end-of-day summary delivered to Director and Venue Manager.

name: Live Score Entry
description: Ref enters scores in real-time from a phone interface during the match.

name: Rainout Decision Form
description:
Structured rainout decision with reason codes feeding refund and reschedule
workflows.

name: Ref Check-in Signature
description:
Ref signs in via QR code at the venue; logs arrival timestamp and ties it to
the assignment.

name: Score Attestation
description:
Both teams' captains/coaches sign the final score before it is posted to
standings.

name: Team Check-in Panel
description:
Per-match roster, jersey, and eligibility verification UI used by Front of
House at venue check-in.

name: Weekly Metrics Run
description: Cross-venue weekly roll-up of attendance, incidents, payroll, and revenue.

name: Photo Upload Capture
description: Generic photo upload tied to activity completion.
